thesis: Nether Void makes every spell cost three additional mana, allowing black prison decks to turn early threats and land destruction into a game where the opponent can no longer participate efficiently.

playbook.role: Resolve a clock or mana advantage first, then deploy Nether Void while the opponent is below the threshold needed to cast meaningful answers. Cheap permanents and land denial make the symmetry deceptive.
